name: MET Norway Locationforecast
summary: Global point weather forecasts, hourly out to about 10 days, from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute.
description: Locationforecast returns a GeoJSON timeseries forecast for any latitude/longitude on Earth, based on the ECMWF model blended with the high-resolution MEPS model over the Nordic region. The compact variant gives instant variables (temperature, wind, humidity, pressure, cloud cover) plus next 1/6/12 hour precipitation and symbol codes. It is the same service that powers yr.no.

auth.notes: No key, but the terms of service require an identifying User-Agent (app name plus contact).

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: App name/version plus contact URL or email; anonymous or default UAs may be blocked.

rate_limit.summary: Max 20 requests/second per application; cache responses and honor Expires / If-Modified-Since; coordinates limited to 4 decimals.

endpoints.summary: Compact forecast timeseries for a point
Full variable set including percentiles and extra levels

license.name: CC BY 4.0 and Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD)

coverage.geographic: Global; best resolution in the Nordic region

agent_notes: Always send a descriptive User-Agent and round coordinates to 4 decimals. Note the GeoJSON coordinate order is [lon, lat, altitude]. Respect the Expires header rather than re-polling the same point.
caveats: Missing or generic User-Agent risks 403 responses or bans.
Coordinates with more than 4 decimals may be rejected or redirected.
Do not poll the same point faster than the Expires header allows.

verification.notes: Called with an identifying User-Agent; a default curl UA also returned 200 but the terms require an ID.

hn.title: Norwegian Meteorological Institute has an excellent free weather API
